mantid_penitent.note: by design: the whole kit is reserved. It stands at 180 and wins by waiting, and the lunge answers your approach.

emerald_mantis:eviscerate.note: asks no distance and costs no press now. It fires when an ally has bled the target, and its own kit cannot.

pit_mauler:verdict.note: fires once sunder_maul breaks a hero with a poise bar. Nothing else in the kit applies it, so on a hero without poise it never does.

tundra_behemoth:flash_freeze.note: asks no distance and costs no press now. It fires when an ally has chilled the target, and its own kit cannot.
